Name: Actualbat's Portrait Refresh
Author: ActualBat
Description:
[size=6]﻿What is this mod?
[/size][size=3]I used [b]Stardew Valley Character Portrait maker (by [size=3]Poltergeister [/size]and Jazzybee[/b][b])[/b] to make the characters then edited them to make them feel and look more like the different characters. The characters currently not finished are: Linus, Shane, Sebastian, Sam, Safari Guy, Fizz, The Wizard, Bear, Governor, Grandpa, Leo, Birdie, and the Answering Machine. This mod was [b]made for SDV 1.6 [/b]and I have [b]NOT [/b]tested it with SDV 1.5 or below.

[b]Will be adding sprites for each character as I update the mod.[/b] 

If you're wondering why I used [size=3]Stardew Valley Character Portrait [/size]maker, well it's because I am very new to doing character (pixel) art and wanted something to start off with. In the future I hope to make all of my own portraits myself in my own art style.

Also this is my first ever mod and I hope you enjoy it!!!

[/size][size=6]Installation.
[/size][size=3]This is a Content Patcher mod but if you don't use [size=3]Content Patcher[/size] then see install Method II.

[/size][size=5]Installation Method I.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]To install with [size=3]Content Patcher[/size]:
Drag the folder from the inside of the .zip file into your mods folder.

[size=5]Installation Method II.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]To install withOUT [size=3]Content Patcher[/size]:
Open the Portrait folder within the .zip and copy all of the .xnb files and open your Stardew content folder and go into portraits (Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits) then create a backup of the files in this folder then overwrite the files in that folder with the ones from this mod.
[/size][/size][size=6]
Additional Notes.
[/size][size=3]Please check out [size=3]Jazzybee and [size=3]Poltergeister's [/size][/size][/size][url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b]Stardew Valley Character Portrait Maker[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/url][size=6]

Credit.
[/size][size=3]Credit goes to Poltergeister for the original art which I then edited for this mod
Jazzybee for making the [size=3]Stardew Valley Character Portrait maker that I used to create the initial portraits.
Please message me in regards to re-uploading this mod and its portraits, [b]you are not allowed to re-upload it without my permission[/b].[/size][/size]
